parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: In this part the examiner will ask you questions about yourself and familiar topics. Give short, natural answers.

questions.question: Do you work or are you a student?
What subject are you studying / What is your job?
Do you enjoy living in your hometown?
What is the most interesting place in your hometown?
Do you prefer reading paper books or e-books?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You have one minute to prepare. Then speak for one to two minutes on the topic below. You may make notes.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a book you enjoyed reading recently.
cue_card_bullets: what kind of book it was
and explain why you enjoyed it

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the topic in Part 2. Give longer, more developed answers.

questions.question: Do people in your country read a lot of books?
What kinds of books are most popular with young people today?
Do you think reading books is more important than using the internet for learning?
How might reading habits change in the future?
